title: Cohesive launch lanes and release-note orchestration for API/Console/Runtime
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Coordinate milestone alignment, scope lock rules, and a single source release-note pipeline for the API, Console, and Runtime teams so customers receive consistent, accurate launch messaging and the engineering teams have a deterministic cut process. This ticket creates: (1) a shared milestone calendar with explicit scope-lock dates per component, (2) a release-note orchestration template and ownership model, (3) a staggered rollback and canary window plan that minimizes customer disruption, and (4) the cross-team comm-lane for prelaunch and postlaunch GTM tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Shared milestone calendar published in Drive and synced to the launch calendar (owners assigned for API, Console, Runtime)
Scope-lock rules agreed and documented with cut-deadline offsets for each lane and automated calendar reminders set
Release-note orchestration template (headline changes, customer-facing impact, migration notes, known issues, rollback instructions) approved by PM, Docs, and Legal
A single release-note PR checklist created in GitHub and linked to the release pipeline; first release uses the checklist
Canary window plan defined with SLO signal thresholds, rollback triggers, and fallback model variants documented
Cross-functional launch runbook (oncall, postmortem cadence, customer comms owner) finalized and distributed to stakeholders
tasks: Draft milestone calendar and propose scope-lock offsets (Owner: Miguel Santos)
Run 30-minute alignment session with ENG, DX, Console PMs to validate dates and constraints
Create release-note orchestration template and circulate to Docs and Legal for sign-off
Implement GitHub release-note checklist and add PR template linking to checklist
Define canary windows per region and capacity tier; coordinate with Runtime SRE for metrics
Author go/no-go decision matrix and publish to launch runbook
Schedule comms runway (prelaunch announcements, embargo handling, customer opt-in flow) with Growth/Marketing
Dry-run the release-note flow using an internal feature toggle to validate timings and ownership
